visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a red tank top, speaks directly to the camera against a solid blue background. She is expressive, using her hands to emphasize points while leaning slightly forward. (2) A graphic overlay appears, showing the poster for the Netflix series 'Better Late Than Single,' followed by the woman gesturing towards it. (3) The scene shifts to show two side-by-side photos of the woman before her weight loss; in one, she holds a product while smiling, and in the second, she is outdoors in winter clothing holding a large cotton candy. (4) The woman is seen walking outdoors on a city sidewalk, passing a green and orange storefront (7-Eleven). She wears a white cardigan over her red top and light-colored shorts. (5) Back indoors, she holds up a clear plastic bag and a bottle of Quaker Oat Drink while smiling excitedly at the camera. (6) She is shown drinking water from a very large glass jug in a living room setting with a patterned pillow behind her. (7) A close-up shot focuses on the label of a Quaker Oat Drink bottle, highlighting the 'no added sugar' text and health certification logos. (8) The woman is seen eating a piece of cooked chicken and then a roasted sweet potato while sitting on a couch. (9) She opens her refrigerator door to reveal several bottles of Quaker Oat Drink neatly arranged in the door shelf. (10) A close-up shot shows a thick, beige liquid being poured from a bottle into a clear glass. (11) The woman holds four different flavors/bottles of Quaker Oat Drink against her chest, smiling broadly and nodding toward the lens. (12) She uncaps one of the bottles and prepares to take a drink as the video ends.
